attribution.title: Glencoe House, 1905
attribution.author:
Publisher: Osler Library of the History of Medicine, McGill University

is Part Of: Marjorie Howard Futcher Albums Collection
attribution.description:
Lord Strathcona's estate, Glencoe, Scotland, 1905
Image Number: FUT2_062-005_P
Description: Lord Strathcona's residence and estate in Glencoe, Scotland. This photograph was taken during Gwendolen Marjorie Howard's 1905 spring and summer trip to Britain. The label for the photograph identifies the residence as the "New House." Lord Strathcona purchased the estate and constructed the house in 1890s.

The fifth photograph of Page 62, Album 2 of the Marjorie Howard Futcher Albums Collection.
